name: Bustling Marketplace
description: The economic heart of the settlement, with local artisans, traveling merchants, and patrons across social classes.
impulses: Buy low, and sell high, tempt and tantalize with wares from near and far
potentialAdversaries: Guards (Bladed Guard, Head Guard), Masked Thief, Merchant

features.name: Tip the Scales
features.description: PCs can gain advantage on a Presence Roll by offering a handful of gold as part of the interaction. Will any coin be accepted, or only local currency? How overt are the PCs in offering this bribe?

features.name: Unexpected Find
features.description: Reveal to the PCs that one of the merchants has something they want or need, such as food from their home, a rare book, magical components, a dubious treasure map, or a magical key.
features.prompt: What cost beyond gold will the merchant ask for in exchange for this rarity?

features.name: Sticky Fingers
features.description: A thief tries to steal something from a PC. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll to notice the thief or lose an item of the GM's choice as the thief escapes to a Close distance. To retrieve the stolen item, the PCs must complete a Progress Countdown (6) to chase down the thief before the thief completes a Consequence Countdown (4) and escapes to their hideout.
features.prompt: What drove this person to pickpocketing? Where is the thief's hideout and how has it avoided notice?

features.name: Crowd Closes In
features.description: When one of the PCs splits from the group, the crowds shift and cut them off from the party.
features.prompt: Where does the crowd's movement carry them? How do they feel about being alone but surrounded?
